source: WriteStallTimeoutHandler closes a connection that is not HTTP (a binary expectation's answer, BinaryRequestProxyingHandler) whose client took none of the bytes waiting for it for responseWriteStallTimeoutMillis, and counts it in mock_server_response_write_stalls_total{protocol=other,scope=connection} (MetricsTest#countsResponseWriteStallsUnderTheirProtocolAndScope). maxRequestBodySize is raised for the 40 MB expectation. logLevel WARN keeps the tens of MB out of the event log, whose rendering starved the timed scenarios replayed in the same process. The 40 MB expectation step opts into a 60 s maxMillis: parsing the body and echoing it back through the unoptimised test build's JSON printer took 3-6 s alone at load ~150, past the 10 s default under the full suite, the large-body allowance replay_body_cap takes
